title: Dividing a positive learning parameter
statement: Given a rational failure parameter in $(0,1/2]$ and a positive natural number $d$, the divided parameter is the original parameter divided by $d$; it again lies in $(0,1/2]$.
hypotheses_covered: Denominator is a positive natural number
